newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds lower, trade at a standstill.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds lower, trade at a standstill.

text.p: Lower high-protein soymeal prices failed to kick-start trading on the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday.
"There isn't any interest anywhere in the market," said one broker.
"You may find people will buy some soymeal if it keeps coming lower, but that's about all," the broker added.
High protein soymeal was offered three to one stg down with prices looking set for a further fall on Thursday after a weaker opening in Chicago.
However, sterling has been weaker against the dollar and this could wipe out any further fall on the U.S. market. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
